title: Mechanochemical Synthesis of Phthalimides from Terpenes via Tandem Diels–Alder and Iodine-Mediated Aromatization

A solvent-minimized, two-step mechanochemical protocol has been developed for the synthesis of terpene-derived phthalimides via sequential Diels–Alder cycloaddition and iodine-mediated aromatization at room temperature. Efficient conversion of isoprene and maleimides...
